message.content:
Based on the image provided, here is a comprehensive design specification for the **Trigger** app landing page:

## **1. Global Design System**

### **Color Palette (Hex Codes)**
- **Primary Green:** `#00C853` (or `#22C55E` - vibrant green used in logo, buttons, accents)
- **Dark Text/Headings:** `#111827` or `#0F172A` (near-black)
- **Body Text:** `#4B5563` or `#374151` (dark gray)
- **Background:** `#FFFFFF` (white) and `#F0FDF4` / `#ECFDF5` (very light mint green sections)
- **Secondary Background:** `#F9FAFB` (light gray for feature cards)
- **Border/Subtle:** `#E5E7EB` (light gray borders)
- **Red Accent:** `#EF4444` (for live indicators, call end buttons)
- **Black/Dark Mode UI:** `#000000` or `#1A1A1A` (shown in phone mockups)

### **Typography**
- **Font Family:** Inter, SF Pro Display, or similar modern sans-serif (clean, geometric)
- **Hierarchy:**
  - **H1 (Hero):** ~48-56px, Bold (700), Dark color, Line-height: 1.1
  - **H2 (Section):** ~24-28px, Semibold (600)
  - **H3 (Card Title):** ~18-20px, Semibold (600)
  - **Body:** ~16px, Regular (400), Gray text
  - **Small/Caption:** ~14px, Medium (500)
  - **Label/Tag:** ~12px, Uppercase, Letter-spacing: 0.05em, Primary Green

---

## **2. Header / Navigation**

**Layout:** Fixed top navigation, full-width, white background with subtle shadow
**Height:** ~72px
**Padding:** 0 5% (or max-width 1280px centered)

### **Elements:**
- **Logo (Left):**
  - Icon: Rounded square (`border-radius: 12px`), Primary Green background
  - Icon inside: White chat bubble/speech icon
  - Text: "TRIGGER" in bold black, "Live · Chat · Call" in smaller gray below
  
- **Navigation Links (Center):** 
  - Horizontal flex layout, gap: 32px
  - Items: Home, About, **Features** (active state - green text), Live Streaming, Pricing, Support, Contact
  - Style: 16px, medium weight, dark gray (active item is green)
  
- **CTA Button (Right):**
  - **"Get Trigger" button**
  - Background: Primary Green `#00C853`
  - Text: White, 16px, Semibold
  - Padding: 12px 28px
  - Border-radius: 8px (fully rounded/pill shape possible)
  - Icon: Phone/Download icon (white) on left side of text
  - Hover state: Slightly darker green `#00B349`

---

## **3. Hero Section**

**Background:** Light mint green gradient (`#F0FDF4` to white), possibly with subtle abstract shapes
**Padding:** 80px 5% 100px
**Layout:** Two-column grid (50% text left, 50% image right), aligned center vertically

### **Left Column (Content):**
- **Label:** "FEATURES" - 12px, uppercase, green, letter-spaced, bold, margin-bottom: 16px
- **Headline:** 
  - "More ways to connect, express and belong."
  - Size: ~52px, Bold (800), Dark color
  - "connect, express and **belong**" - "connect, express" in green (`#00C853`), "and belong" in dark
  - Max-width: ~500px, line-height: 1.15
  
- **Subheadline:**
  - "Trigger brings together real-time communication, live streaming and social interaction in one powerful app. Discover all the features that make Trigger a global 18+ community."
  - Color: Gray `#6B7280`, Size: 18px, Line-height: 1.6, Max-width: 480px, Margin-top: 24px

- **Stats Row (below subheadline):**
  - Display: Flex, Gap: 40px, Margin-top: 48px
  - Each stat:
    - Number: **Bold, 20-24px**, Dark color (e.g., "50,000+", "4.8 / 5.0", "18+")
    - Label: **Regular, 14px**, Gray (e.g., "Android Installs", "User Rating", "Global Community")
    - Last item: "Secure & Private" (text only, no number)

### **Right Column (Visual):**
- **Phone Mockups:** Three overlapping smartphones at angles
  - **Center Phone (Front):** Shows "Live" streaming interface with video of person, chat overlay, "LIVE" red badge, viewer count "1.2K", interaction buttons (heart, comment, share)
  - **Left Phone (Behind):** Shows chat list interface with user avatars, online indicators (green dots), "LIVE" tags on some users
  - **Right Phone (Behind):** Shows active video call interface with "Riya 00:34", mute/video/speaker controls, red end call button
  - **Phones have:** Rounded corners (realistic device frames), status bars showing time (12:30), battery, signal
  - **Shadow:** Soft drop shadows creating depth/layering effect

- **Decorative Text (Right side of phones):**
  - Handwritten-style script font, Green color (`#22C55E`)
  - Vertical orientation, rotated slightly
  - Text: "Connect Stream Chat Call Be You"
  - Acts as decorative accent element

---

## **4. Features Grid Section**

**Background:** White
**Padding:** 80px 5%
**Layout:** CSS Grid, 3 columns, gap: 32px (responsive: 2 cols tablet, 1 col mobile)

### **Feature Card Structure (Repeated 9 times):**

**Card Styling:**
- Background: White or very light gray `#FAFAFA`
- Border-radius: 16px
- Padding: 32px
- Border: 1px solid `#F3F4F6` (subtle)
- Hover effect: Subtle shadow lift (translateY: -4px)

**Internal Layout (per card):** Flex row (image left, content right) OR column on mobile

#### **Card 1: Real-time Chat**
- **Image (Left):** Phone mockup showing chat interface with message bubbles, user avatars, green online indicators, input field at bottom
- **Title (Right):** "Real-time Chat" - 20px, Bold, Dark
- **Description:** "Stay connected with instant and secure messaging. Share text, photos, videos and more." - 15px, Gray, line-height 1.6
- **CTA Link:** "Learn more →" - Green text, 15px, Semibold, arrow icon, margin-top: 16px

#### **Card 2: Audio & Video Calls**
- **Image:** Phone showing video call interface with person's face, bottom control bar (mute, camera flip, speaker, end call)
- **Title:** "Audio & Video Calls"
- **Description:** "High-quality 1-on-1 calls with crystal-clear audio and smooth video."
- **CTA:** "Learn more →"

#### **Card 3: Live Streaming**
- **Image:** Phone showing live stream with "LIVE" red badge (top left), "1.2K" viewers (top right), creator face, "Follow" button (green), heart/comment icons
- **Title:** "Live Streaming"
- **Description:** "Go live, interact with your audience and build your community. Host free or paid live streams."
- **CTA:** "Learn more →"

#### **Card 4: Discover People**
- **Image:** Phone showing profile view of user "Meera" with photo, "Online" badge, X and heart buttons (bottom)
- **Title:** "Discover People"
- **Description:** "Find and connect with real people from around the world."
- **CTA:** "Learn more →"

#### **Card 5: Live Discovery**
- **Image:** Phone showing grid of live streams (2x2 or 2x3 grid), each with "LIVE" tag, viewer counts (e.g., "1.2K", "892"), thumbnails of streamers
- **Tabs above grid:** "For You", "Popular", "Nearby" (with "For You" active/green)
- **Title:** "Live Discovery"
- **Description:** "Explore live streams from creators worldwide. Follow, like and support your favorites."
- **CTA:** "Learn more →"

#### **Card 6: Secure & Private**
- **Image (Icon-based, not phone):** List format with icons
  - Lock icon + "Privacy"
  - Blocked circle icon + "Blocked Users"  
  - Flag icon + "Report User"
  - Shield-check icon + "Two-Step Verification"
  - All icons in dark gray/black, text in dark, clean list layout
- **Title:** "Secure & Private"
- **Description:** "Your privacy matters. Advanced security features to keep your conversations and data safe."
- **CTA:** "Learn more →"

#### **Card 7: Wallet & Earnings**
- **Image:** UI component showing green card/wallet interface
  - "Wallet Balance" header (white text on green)
  - "₹ 12,580" (large white bold text)
  - "Withdraw" button (white background, green text)
  - Below: Table showing "Earnings ₹8,950" | "Withdrawals ₹3,630"
- **Title:** "Wallet & Earnings"
- **Description:** "Monetize your content, receive earnings and withdraw to your bank account. Transparent and secure payouts."
- **CTA:** "Learn more →"

#### **Card 8: Global Community**
- **Image:** Illustration of globe/world map (green tones) surrounded by circular avatars of diverse people (8-10 faces) connected by lines or orbiting
- **Title:** "Global Community"
- **Description:** "Trigger is a global 18+ platform. Meet, chat and connect with people from different countries and cultures."
- **CTA:** "Learn more →"

#### **Card 9: User Safety**
- **Image (Icon list):** Similar to Card 6 but safety-focused
  - Shield icon + "Report Content"
  - User-block icon + "Block User"
  - Warning/icon + "Safety Guidelines"
  - Users/icon + "Community Rules"
- **Title:** "User Safety"
- **Description:** "We are committed to a safe and respectful community. Powerful tools to report, block and stay safe."
- **CTA:** "Learn more →"

---

## **5. Download CTA Section (Footer Hero)**

**Background:** Light mint green (`#F0FDF5` or `#ECFDF5`), possibly with subtle gradient or pattern
**Padding:** 80px 5%
**Layout:** Two-column (Text left, Phone right)

### **Left Column:**
- **Label:** "READY TO CONNECT?" - 14px, uppercase, letter-spaced, gray/dark, margin-bottom: 16px
- **Headline:** "Get Trigger for Android" - 40-48px, Bold, Dark color ("Android" could be regular weight)
- **Subtext:** "Join a global 18+ community. Chat, call, stream and be part of something real." - 18px, Gray, max-width: 500px, line-height 1.6, margin-top: 16px
- **Button (margin-top: 32px):**
  - **"Download on Android →"**
  - Background: Primary Green `#00C853`
  - Text: White, Bold, 16px
  - Padding: 16px 32px (larger than nav button)
  - Border-radius: 8-10px
  - Icon: Android robot logo (white) on left
  - Arrow icon on right
  - Hover: Darker green + slight scale

### **Right Column:**
- **Single large phone mockup** (centered, larger than hero phones)
- Screen shows: 
  - Large Trigger logo (green square with white bubble)
  - "TRIGGER" text below
  - "Live · Chat · Call" tagline
  - Three lines of text: "Connect", "Stream", "Belong" (stacked, centered)
  - Clean white background on phone screen
  
- **Decorative Text (Right of phone):**
  - Handwritten script, Green
  - "Same App Different Stories" (vertical/angled)
  - Matches style of hero section decoration

---

## **6. Spacing & Layout Specifications**

- **Container Max-Width:** 1280px (centered with auto margins)
- **Section Padding Vertical:** 80-120px
- **Grid Gaps:** 24-32px
- **Card Padding:** 24-32px internal
- **Border Radius:**
  - Buttons: 8-10px (medium rounded)
  - Cards: 16-20px (large rounded)
  - Phone Mockups: 24-32px (device corners)
  - Avatars: 50% (circular)
- **Shadows:**
  - Cards: `0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)` (subtle)
  - Phones: `0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)` (dramatic, realistic)
  - Buttons: `0 4px 6px rgba(0,200,83,0.2)` (green tinted)

---

## **7. Iconography Style**

- **Style:** Outlined (stroke) or filled, consistent stroke width (2px)
- **Icons Used:**
  - Navigation: Phone/Download (header CTA)
  - Features: Message bubble, Video camera, Phone, Globe, Shield/Lock, Wallet/Credit card, Users/People, Flag/Report, Ban/Block, Checkmark verification
  - Arrows: Right arrow (→) for "Learn more" links
  - Social: Heart (outline and filled), Comment bubble, Share, Follow button
  - Status: "LIVE" badges (red pill shape), Online indicators (green dot 8-10px)
  - Platform: Android robot (download section)

---

## **8. Button Variants**

1. **Primary Button (Solid):**
   - Background: `#00C853`
   - Text: White
   - Hover: `#00B349`
   - Shadow: Subtle green glow
   
2. **Text Button/Link:**
   - Background: Transparent
   - Text: `#00C853` (Green)
   - Icon: Arrow right (→)
   - Hover: Underline or darker green

3. **Secondary/Ghost Button (implied):**
   - Border: 1px solid `#E5E7EB`
   - Background: White or transparent
   - Text: Dark gray

---

## **9. Image/Mockup Specifications**

- **Phone Frames:** Realistic device mockups (likely iPhone/Android proportions)
- **Screen Content:** Actual app UI screenshots (not illustrations)
- **Treatment:** Drop shadows for depth, slight rotation (-5° to +5°) for dynamic feel
- **Overlapping:** Z-index layering to create stack effect in hero
- **Avatars:** Circular, 40-48px in lists, larger in profiles

This design follows a **modern SaaS/app landing page aesthetic** with generous whitespace, vibrant green accent color against neutral backgrounds, and product-focused imagery showcasing the actual application interface.
